Record Class TextImage.TextStyle

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.TextImage.TextStyle
Enclosing class:
TextImage
public static record TextImage.TextStyle(int textRgb, int backingRgb, int backingAlpha, TextImage.Align align, TextImage.TextFont font) extends Record
How coloured text looks beyond its codes: the colour of letters without a code of their own (-1: white), the colour and strength (0 to 255) of what goes behind them (-1: the backing's own black and strength), and where the lines sit. Since API_VERSION 5.
